notes.title: Now Available! Fast-Paced Turn-Based Roguelike – Fadedlands: The Reckless Squad!
notes.notes: [p]Fast-Paced Turn-Based Roguelike! [b]Fadedlands: The Reckless Squad[/b] Sets Off on an Adventure! ⚔️🌲[/p][p]Developed by solo developer [b]ForindGames[/b] and published by [b]OKJOY[/b], the pixel-style, fast-paced turn-based roguelike [b]Fadedlands: The Reckless Squad[/b] officially launched on Steam today (August 15). 🎉[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545437/84828ad01c8130d0d558f1b385e9ebb3a99ab560.png"][/img][/p][p]The game is currently available at a [b]10% launch discount[/b] for only [b]5.39$[/b], and you can also download the [b]free demo[/b] from the store page. 🆓💾[/p][p]There’s also a special [b]bundle deal[/b] with [i]TinyFolks[/i] and Stray Path, giving you even bigger savings! 💰[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530490/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Fadedlands: The Reckless Squad[/b] is a turn-based game where you can dodge enemy skills through strategic movement, blending roguelike elements with squad building and camp management. While battles are fully automated, you must choose the right moments to move or attack, upgrade and customize your card deck during your adventure, strengthen your squad, and uncover the secrets hidden in the forest! 🌿[/p][p][/p][h3]Compared to the demo version, the full release includes these [b]core additions[/b]:[/h3][list][*][p]🏕 [b]Complete Camp System:[/b] Gain experience from adventures, complete training courses, and earn badges, medals, and blessings from the forest![/p][/*][*][p]🧙‍♂️ [b]More Playable Characters:[/b] Seven unique adventurers, each with their own special skills—assemble your ultimate squad![/p][/*][*][p]🔓 [b]New Adventure Difficulties & Hidden True Ending:[/b] Discover the fate of the prince by venturing deeper into the wilds![/p][/*][*][p]💎 [b]Powerful Rune Workshop & Shop:[/b] Collect and unlock upgrades to take your builds to the next level![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you’re ready for an exciting challenge, join this epic adventure today! 🚀[/p][p][b]Join our Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2"]https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2[/url][/p]

notes.title: "Fadedlands: The Reckless Squad" launches its adventure on August 15!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey adventurers![/b]
Ready to lead the most [i]reckless[/i] squad in rogue-like strategy history?
[b]Fadedlands: The Reckless Squad[/b], a fast-paced turn-based tactical roguelite, officially launches on [b]August 15th at 1:00 AM (PDT)[/b] on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]💰 [b]Launch Price: $5.99 → 10% OFF = Only $5.39![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530490/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]What kind of game is this?[/b][/h3][p]When your entire squad is made up of [i]“gifted individuals”[/i]:[/p][p]✅ A soldier who's mastered the art of "tactical retreat" (Let someone else tank!)
✅ A rookie lumberjack (Spins so hard he knocks [i]himself[/i] out 🌀)
✅ A hyperactive bard (Can’t sing without dancing—literally!)
✅ A clueless blacksmith (The longer he spaces out, the harder he hits)[/p][p](…And many more "reliable" and hilarious heroes to discover!)[/p][p][b]Your mission:[/b] Lead them out of the cursed forest alive and uncover the secrets of the Tree of Life.
(Or at least go down in glorious chaos!)[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Game Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🧠 [b]Unique Strategy Gameplay:[/b]
No perfect plan—only clever improvisation (and epic fails in style)![/p][/*][*][p]🃏 [b]Roguelike Deckbuilding:[/b]
Lightning + Spread Shot = Chain Lightning combo?[/p][/*][*][p]🏕️ [b]Camp Building & Roguelite Progression:[/b]
Party wiped out? No worries! Head back, train up, and dive in again![/p][/*][*][p]😈 [b]Dark Humor Storyline:[/b]
What if… goblins are actually the most harmless and loyal companions…???[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Compared to the demo, the full version adds a wealth of core content![/b][/h3][list][*][p]🌲 [b]Complete Camp System:[/b]
Gain experience through adventure, complete training courses, and earn badges, medals, and the forest's blessings![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545437/46c0ac1464def15bc6b806478ce9abf6164b34f1.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]🧙 [b]More Playable Characters:[/b]
Seven unique adventurers! Combine their distinct abilities to form your ultimate squad![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545437/d1314c278145937fe20e1917b161862d5d6daeaf.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]🎯 [b]New Difficulty Levels & Hidden True Ending:[/b]
What happens to the prince? Embark on the full adventure to find out![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545437/3e40c54ac0b3b193f3e721674bbbe7aa67363d5f.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]💎 [b]Powerful Rune Workshop & Shop System:[/b]
Collect and unlock upgrades to take your builds to the next level![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545437/4e0343ac878c6b9711153239493303ca93d6c4db.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Join our Discord:[url="https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2"]https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🌲 Demo Now Live for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [p]Face the unknown. Build your squad. Survive the forest.[/p][p]The Tree of Life has withered—its roots tainted by something dark and ancient. The prince who went to investigate never returned. Now, it's your turn![/p][p] [/p][p]In [b]Fadedlands: The Reckless Squad[/b], you'll lead a team of bold (maybe too bold) adventurers into the heart of a decaying forest. This is a turn-based roguelike with a twist: battles are automated, but your timing and movement matter. Dodge deadly skills, reposition strategically, and unleash powerful combos as you build your squad and upgrade your deck mid-run.[/p][p]🔹 Explore the shadows.[/p][p]🔹 Build your reckless team.[/p][p]🔹 Unlock new cards, relics, and secrets.[/p][p]🔹 Face off against mysterious foes who play by their own rules.[/p][p] [/p][p]🧭 [b]The demo is now available during Steam Next Fest[/b] — play it, share your stories, and don’t forget to wishlist the game if you're ready to take on the forest’s twisted heart.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530490/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you all for support![/p][h3][b]Follow our community to get the latest information![/b][/h3][p]💬[b]Discord:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2"]https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2[/url][/p][p][/p]
